Name: Daher End-Admission Audit
Description: Technical audit record only, not a clinical field. Written once by the daherendadmission module when a Daher Maternity Admission Visit is ended, to durably record which OpenMRS user initiated the action (native Visit.changedBy is overwritten by the module's system-execution context and cannot be used for this). Never displayed in clinical UI. See ADR-030 (DECISIONS.md).
